scope: Design and code preparation only; no formal data generation, optimizer updates or submitted jobs.

initialization.world_model: fresh seed 0, no old damped checkpoint

optimization.schedule: original full-budget warmup/cosine; pause using stop-after-step, never steps override

requirements: inspect fixed train diagnostic windows against initialization and persistence
check representation and motion do not collapse
milestones.note: Training diagnostic is not a generalization claim; h8 and h32 validation remains recorded; do not require h32 gate yet.

requirements: h8 prediction gates pass in all dynamic time strata

milestones.purpose: retain short-horizon quality and inspect longer rollout
requirements: record h32 position/motion/stall trends versus step 4000
investigate persistent drift or collapse before extending
milestones.note: h32 is diagnostic here, not an unconditional prerequisite for training h32.

requirements: best.pt passes full h8/h32 latent gates
milestones.next_stage: B only after recorded acceptance; no automatic continuation

latent_gate_definitions.relative_error: pooled squared velocity error / pooled target velocity power
latent_gate_definitions.pooling: all dynamic time strata; preserve existing representation gate time bins

checkpoints.resume: last.pt, new empty output directory per segment; preserve sibling best.pt if present
checkpoints.best: existing full h8/h32 gate unchanged, may not exist in early segments
checkpoints.promotion: manual evidence review; shell script only enforces bounded execution and previous checkpoint step

physical_validation_design.implementation_status: planned; independent stage-A val-only physical evaluator must be completed and checked before stage A promotion
physical_validation_design.fit_split: deterministically permute 384 training group IDs with numpy default_rng seed 5705; first 288 for ridge fitting, remaining 96 for ridge selection
physical_validation_design.labels: sin(theta), cos(theta), omega from training episodes only; frames 20..80 inclusive; no world-model gradient
physical_validation_design.readout: standardize q,p features and output targets using fit subset only, standard-deviation floor 1e-6; ridge with unpenalized intercept minimizing mean squared error + alpha * squared coefficients; alpha grid [1e-6,1e-4,1e-2,1,100]; select normalized target MSE on remaining 96 train groups
physical_validation_design.val: freeze selected readout; all 64 val episodes, anchors 20,32,48; h8/h32 future remains within frame 80; no test access

readout_quality_gate.failure_action: physical conclusions inconclusive; diagnose representation/readout, do not attribute to dynamics or promote

physical_validation_design.energy_diagnostic: physical E=0.5*omega^2+9.81*(1-cos(theta)); report initial reconstruction error and relative trajectory drift with denominator max(true E at anchor, 0.05*9.81); do not substitute latent balance for physical accuracy
physical_validation_design.aggregation: episode-equal within each horizon; report all initial-energy strata and failure cases; no window resampling to hide failures
physical_validation_design.threshold_policy: initial design targets, not achieved results; version changes explicitly and do not relax after seeing held-out failures

metric_definitions.angle_error: abs(atan2(sin(theta_pred-theta_true), cos(theta_pred-theta_true))); angle=atan2(predicted sin, predicted cos)
metric_definitions.omega_nrmse: omega RMSE / max(standard deviation of true omega in 288-group readout-fit subset, 1e-6)
metric_definitions.baseline_improvement: at each horizon, compare episode-equal aggregate angle MAE against the better aggregate of the two static baselines; no per-window oracle baseline selection
metric_definitions.readout_quality_sampling: same 64 val episodes and anchors as autonomous evaluation; teacher-encoded states use causal histories at anchor and each future scoring frame, strictly in a separate readout-only diagnostic, never injected into autonomous rollout
metric_definitions.motion_aggregation: use readout-predicted omega and true omega at the same future frames, not finite differences of wrapped angles; pool powers with episode-equal weights within each horizon; dynamic/stall fractions are per window; also report energy-stratified values
metric_definitions.energy_drift: for each episode and anchor, max_t abs(E_pred(t)-E_pred(anchor)) / max(E_true(anchor), 0.05*9.81); average its three anchor values per episode, then compute median and p90 over 64 episodes; initial reconstruction error separate

stop_and_diagnose: h8 still stops/drifts or fails persistence comparison at step 4000
multi-energy trajectories cannot be fit together
final latent or physical gates fail; do not use damping to compensate conservative errors

later_stages.name: B
later_stages.initialization: explicit validated warm-start transfer of accepted A modules; initialize new D/context; new optimizer; not exact resume
requirements: positive dissipation matches physical decay without premature stopping
seen and unseen damping validation protocol fixed before run

later_stages.name: C
later_stages.purpose: joint small-learning-rate refinement only if B passes
requirements: retain undamped replay and physical motion gates
controlled ablations and independent final test
